what: Validator-Override baseline seeding is documented but not implemented in the script contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan edge case and SKILL Step 2b validator-Override prose require the first successful retained Step 2b.5 parse to write drift-baseline.env when absent, but the proposed check-plan-size.sh changes only read drift-baseline.env and emit DRIFT_* KVs; design-postplan-emit.sh exits 10 before _postplan_run_plan_size on validator defects, so Override runs standalone Step 2b.5 with no baseline and drift stays disabled for the rest of the run
suggested_fix: Add a write-once block to check-plan-size.sh (or an equally named helper) that writes BASELINE_PLAN_LINES and BASELINE_DIFF_LINES to drift-baseline.env when the file is absent, using the same keys and guard as design-postplan-emit.sh; align check-plan-size.md with that producer
